command: Miscanthus lutarioriparius NCGR_LOCUS10166 (A0A811MX19/CAD6214881.1/Ml02G067130.1) is a functional HDH-ARV fusion with retained ARV lipid-homeostasis roles and ER, plastid-stroma or cytosolic localization. Evaluate each claim independently, including authentic fusion versus annotation error or alternative processing. Deposited candidate spans chromosome2 CAJGYO010000002.1:132579639-132586856 (reverse strand); separate HDH CAD6206931.1/Ml01G065970.1 and ARV CAD6206930.1/Ml01G065960.1 are adjacent chromosome1 models with a 1050-bp gap. This is real adjacency but does not prove chromosome2 model error. Reproducible local alignment gives HDH 460/472 identity and retained E368/H369 plus Q300/H303/D402/H461; ARV 171/193 alignment-column identity with divergent termini. UniProt missing-residue warning is ARV rule RU368065, not HDH. PMID16725371 explicitly finds cysteine-rich ARV subdomain deletion tolerated, while the C-terminal AHD subdomain is essential; map actual functional residues rather than equating the protein tail with that subdomain. Seek genomic/transcript/junction/protein evidence and exact TreeGrafter placement for localization. Distinguish direct sterol transport from indirect lipid-homeostasis effects. Unrelated functions, putative targeting signals, lack of target assays or missing cysteines alone do not demonstrate loss.
